fusions.name: Raking Barb
fusions.desc: A raking pull of the trowel point that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to make it [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wall-Tie Snag
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed wall-tie at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Snag and Haul
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next strike has 15% more critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
